faq_q1: What documents do I need to apply for a Malaysia work visa?
faq_a1: You will need a valid passport, passport-size photographs, medical report, educational certificates, and an employment offer letter. Our team will guide you through the full checklist.
faq_q2: How long does the visa process take?
faq_a2: The entire process typically takes 4-6 weeks, from application to flight departure, depending on the employer and current processing times.
faq_q3: What is the cost of the visa process?
faq_a3: We charge transparent, government-approved fees. You will receive an official fee breakdown before starting and receipts for all payments.
faq_q4: Can my family travel with me?
faq_a4: The standard work visa covers the worker only. For family or dependent visa details, please contact our office for specific guidance.
faq_q5: Do I need to attend an embassy interview?
faq_a5: Many applicants are required to attend an embassy interview. We provide full preparation guidance and support before your scheduled appointment.
faq_a6: You can track your application status anytime using your tracking ID from our Track page, or contact our support team for live updates.
faq_q6: How do I track the status of my application?
